title: Show HN: Jevstiller – Distill Jev into a local model, with a disagreement bound
summary: Jevstiller is a tool that distills the Jev model into a smaller local model while providing theoretical disagreement bounds to quantify when the distilled model might diverge from the original. It appears to combine model compression with uncertainty quantification to enable reliable local deployments.
problem_solved: Enables running compressed versions of large models locally with theoretical guarantees about prediction reliability and disagreement with the original model.
why_valuable: Provides a principled approach to local AI deployment by combining model distillation with rigorous uncertainty bounds, helping users understand when they can trust the distilled model's outputs.
